about: Renovating an apartment in Maxima Residence: from one-bedroom to large

The complex has both compact apartments of about 50 m² and large ones up to 181 m². In a small apartment ergonomics is key: a kitchen-living room with an island or breakfast bar, a niche for the washing machine, a wardrobe instead of a separate room. In a large one — zoning, a second bathroom and space for a study.
Many business-class owners renovate to let. In that case we recommend hard-wearing materials, a neutral palette and easy-care furniture — the apartment looks new for longer and finds a tenant faster.
In a new building the management company usually sets hours for noisy works and the procedure for using the lift. We take this into account in the schedule and remove construction waste ourselves.
For reference: developer — RIEL & Bosphorus Development, address — 30 Yevhena Konovaltsia St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Maxima Residence cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 80 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
Do you renovate apartments for letting?
Yes. We choose hard-wearing materials, practical furniture and a neutral interior that appeals to most tenants. We can fully furnish the apartment before move-in.
Can I start with the design project and decide on the renovation later?
Yes, the design project is a separate service from $30/m². But the ±5% estimate guarantee applies only if CAS does the renovation.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
